projects.title: Semiconductor Defect Detection System
projects.description: Collaborated with 2-engineer team to build semiconductor defect detection system achieving 98% precision using YOLOv3 and RetinaNet. Engineered computer vision pipeline with OpenCV, Hough Transform, Canny edge detection, and ResNet achieving 0.2-second inference time. Developed WPF application for complete ML workflow (annotation, training, inference, evaluation).
